answer: What survives to the pearl is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, expired if not renewed by fresh work, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The ember lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the delta is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
